MPESB Primary Teacher PSTST 2025 Upload Special DELED Document - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Result for the post of Primary School Prathamik Shikshak MP PTST. This recruitment was released for 13089 posts. Applications for the MPESB PSTST Primary Teacher Recruitment 2025 were accepted from July 18, 2025, to August 25, 2025. The written examination is going to be conducted on 09 October 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their MPESB PSTST Primary Teacher Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 12 July 2025
  • Application Start Date : 18 July 2025
  • Last Date : 25 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 August 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 26 August 2025
  • Exam Date : 09 October 2025
  • Admit Card Available : 01 October 2025
  • Answer Key Available : 15 October 2025
  • Correction/ Edit Form Date : 04-11 February 2026
  • Result : 27 February 2026
  • Upload Special DELED Document : 24 June to 08 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • OBC, SC, ST : Rs. 310/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
